requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Solution
requirements.Description: Develop HP’s first business ink tank printer targeted at SMBs, offering high-performance, cost-effective printing with low total cost of ownership (TCO).
requirements.Rationale: HP needs to fill a gap in the CISS PLE Hi segment and defend its SMB market share from competitors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is released with ink tank technology, achieves lowest business TCO, and is marketed as HP’s first business ink tank.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI features for productivity and manageability, including Perfect Print, Perfect Scan, and an SMB portal for device management.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require easy-to-use, efficient solutions to manage their business printing without dedicated IT teams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features (Perfect Print/Scan) and SMB portal are fully functional and tested in the released product.

requirements.Title: Consolidated Portal for Device Management (SMB Portal)
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage printers, targeting unmanaged or lightly managed businesses, supporting device registration, setup, and ongoing management.
requirements.Rationale: Office managers and generalist IT staff need a simple, unified interface to manage multiple printers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is available, supports all required device management functions, and is validated with SMB user groups.

requirements.Title: Maintenance-Free or Reduced Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design printer with maintenance-free or less maintenance features, including customer-replaceable parts and a replaceable maintenance box.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs without dedicated IT teams need printers that require minimal intervention and are easy to service.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is customer-replaceable, printer requires fewer parts to replace over its lifetime compared to competitors.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure printer is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), surpassing competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator for SMB customers and aligns with HP’s corporate goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Final product is independently verified to contain minimum 60% RCP in its construction.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Offer warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever is first). Implement PHA (customer replaceable parts) and MINK (service center replaceable parts) thresholds for serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need reliable products with clear service options and minimal downtime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published, serviceability features implemented, and customer replaceability tested.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refill
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles for ink refilling to prevent incorrect installation and ensure ease of use for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error and simplifies maintenance for non-IT staff.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink refill bottles are keyed, tested for user error prevention, and validated in usability studies.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance
requirements.Description: PDL SKU must support improved speed (25/20 min vs. current 25/19), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive performance and compliance are required for market success.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU meets speed targets, supports PDL/PS, and achieves Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing functionality through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs increasingly use mobile devices and require convenient printing solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: HP App supports mobile printing for Magellan printers, validated by SMB user testing.

requirements.Title: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal Support (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Non-PDL SKU must support SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, and enable Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).
requirements.Rationale: Expands solution offerings for SMBs and supports HP’s PaaS strategy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU is integrated with SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, PaaS functionality is enabled.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for remote monitoring, device health, and usage analytics.
requirements.Rationale: HP and SMBs need visibility into device performance for proactive support and optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry features are implemented, data is accessible via SMB portal, and meets HP analytics standards.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Magellan must support Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) capabilities for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP’s strategic goal for PaaS acceleration and coverage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer is compatible with HP’s PaaS offerings, validated in pilot deployments.
